From the desk, not a template
YAM Logistics has held a customs broker licence (R-7/92) since 1992. The tools use the same notifications and rules we file shipping bills and bills of entry against.
Tariff, drawback and RoDTEP data is refreshed when new notifications come out, and exchange rates update daily.
A person when you need one
A tool gives you a first answer. If your case is unusual, a licensed broker will check it with you on WhatsApp, usually within two working hours.
Yes. No sign-up, no email, no limit on how often you use them. We built them because these are the questions importers and exporters ask us every day.

They use the latest CBIC tariff, drawback and RoDTEP notifications, DGFT export policy and IATA dangerous goods rules. They are a strong first answer, but classification and final duty are decided on the bill of entry or shipping bill, so check unusual cases with a broker.
Do you store what I type?
No. The calculators run in your browser. Nothing you enter is sent to us unless you choose to send it to the desk.
Can YAM Logistics handle the shipment after I use a tool?
Yes. We are a licensed customs broker and freight forwarder with offices in New Delhi, Mumbai and Mundra. Send us your result and we will quote for the clearance and freight.
